// Build this captured probe from a temporary .go copy for native Linux mount qualification.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/asalimonov/gquorum/fault"
	"github.com/asalimonov/gquorum/internal/recoverydisk"
	model "github.com/asalimonov/gquorum/internal/recoverymodel"
	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,err); os.Exit(1) }
}

func run() error {
	paths:=model.Paths{StorageDir:"/fixture/system",LoadWALDir:"/fixture/wal"}
	if len(os.Args)==2 && os.Args[1]=="setup" {
		for _,path:=range []string{paths.StorageDir,filepath.Join(paths.LoadWALDir,"artifact","nested")} {
			if err:=os.MkdirAll(path,0700);err!=nil{return err}
		}
		return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(paths.LoadWALDir,"artifact","data"),[]byte("original"),0600)
	}
	owner,err:=recoverydisk.Acquire(context.Background(),paths)
	if err!=nil{return err}
	defer owner.Close()
	root,nested:=unix.Stat_t{},unix.Stat_t{}
	if err:=unix.Stat(paths.LoadWALDir,&root);err!=nil{return err}
	if err:=unix.Stat(filepath.Join(paths.LoadWALDir,"artifact","nested"),&nested);err!=nil{return err}
	if root.Dev!=nested.Dev{return errors.New("fixture did not produce a same-device bind mount")}
	err=owner.ValidateArtifact(context.Background(),"wal","artifact",4096)
	if !errors.Is(err,fault.ErrUnreadable) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(),"nested artifact mount") {
		return fmt.Errorf("same-device nested mount was not specifically refused: %v",err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("PASS: same device %d, distinct mount identity refused; source bytes preserved\n",root.Dev)
	data,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(paths.LoadWALDir,"artifact","data"))
	if err!=nil{return err}
	if string(data)!="original"{return errors.New("source bytes changed")}
	return nil
}
